title: Asian Tofu Stir-Fry with Pineapple, Bok Choy & Coconut Rice

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and onion powder in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a medium bowl, then sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Gently toss to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, turning occasionally, until golden and crispy, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve both skillet and bowl for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut bok choy crosswise into 1-inch strips. Place in the reserved bowl.
Wash, dry, and cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bok choy and pineapple; stir-fry until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Return tofu to the skillet along with the stir-fry sauce. Continue to stir-fry until sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Just before serving, fluff rice with a fork. Add coconut and stir to combine.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
